goal.title: Apply conditional probability to screening tests
goal.learningTarget: Apply conditional probability to screening tests

sourceDocuments.name: Synthetic study notes
sourceDocuments.text: For a synthetic screening model, sensitivity is P(positive|condition), specificity is P(negative|no condition), and prevalence is P(condition). All rates concern the same population. Use whole-number hypothetical populations where helpful. A change in sample size alone does not alter a conditional probability. No medical advice or real test claims.

goal.focusAreas: String length, case, whitespace and list indexing

sourceDocuments.name: Synthetic study notes
sourceDocuments.text: Python 3 strings retain spaces and case. len counts Unicode code points, not visible glyphs. List indexes start at zero. A slice excludes its stop index. Preserve literal spaces and indentation when quoting code.

goal.title: Trace SQLite queries with duplicates and NULL
goal.learningTarget: Trace SQLite queries with duplicates and NULL
contentTopics: LEFT JOIN, WHERE, COUNT and NULL
goal.focusAreas: LEFT JOIN, WHERE, COUNT and NULL

sourceDocuments.name: Synthetic study notes
sourceDocuments.text: Use SQLite semantics. COUNT(*) counts rows; COUNT(expression) counts non-NULL expression values. A LEFT JOIN emits a NULL-extended row for each unmatched left row. WHERE filters after the join; an equality comparison involving NULL is unknown and is not retained by WHERE. Show all needed table rows in each question.

goal.title: Choose English articles while preserving meaning
goal.learningTarget: Choose English articles while preserving meaning

sourceDocuments.name: Synthetic study notes
sourceDocuments.text: English count singular nouns usually need a determiner. Generic plural and mass nouns may use no article: Tigers are mammals; Water is essential. The can signal contextually identifiable specific referents. A mass noun can become countable for a serving or type. Interpret the whole context; grammatical alternatives can differ in meaning.

goal.title: Distinguish adoption, signing and chronology in American independence
goal.learningTarget: Distinguish adoption, signing and chronology in American independence
contentTopics: Events in 1776 and what dated records establish
goal.focusAreas: Events in 1776 and what dated records establish

sourceDocuments.name: Synthetic study notes
sourceDocuments.text: Synthetic summary of historical chronology: The Continental Congress voted for independence on July 2, 1776, adopted the Declaration text on July 4, and most delegates signed the engrossed parchment on August 2. Additional signatures were added later. Adoption of text and signature dates are different events. Ask only about these events or inferences from this chronology.

goal.title: Reason about food-web energy and measurement
goal.learningTarget: Reason about food-web energy and measurement
contentTopics: Production versus standing biomass and transfer efficiency
goal.focusAreas: Production versus standing biomass and transfer efficiency

sourceDocuments.name: Synthetic study notes
sourceDocuments.text: In this simplified annual food web, energy production is measured in kJ per year, and standing biomass in g at one instant. Transfer efficiency from a prey to a consumer is consumer production attributable to that prey divided by prey production, with both over the same interval. Diet shares describe fractions of consumer intake, not fractions of prey production eaten. Standing biomass alone does not determine annual production.
